Name: TenantTokens
DatabaseIdentificationScript: SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datistemplate = false AND datname = '{{MainDB}}'
SchemaIdentificationScript: SELECT nspname FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname LIKE 'perdbcache_%' ORDER BY nspname

ScriptTokens.PerDbToken: <*Query*>WITH side AS (INSERT INTO public.token_call_counter (token_kind, iteration_schema) VALUES ('PerDb', '') RETURNING 1) SELECT 'perdb_value' FROM side
ScriptTokens.IterationToken: <*Query*>WITH side AS (INSERT INTO public.token_call_counter (token_kind, iteration_schema) VALUES ('Iteration', '{{SchemaName}}') RETURNING 1) SELECT 'iter_value_{{SchemaName}}' FROM side
